sections.title: We deliver more than *ready mix*
sections.intro: Service is everything. That is what a hometown family business is all about.

items.title: Front discharge mixers
items.text: The driver controls the chute from inside the cab for more accurate placement, fewer support crew and a safer, more efficient job site.

items.title: 4 cubic yard mixers
items.text: Perfect for tight locations a conventional truck cannot reach. Two are front-wheel drive for even tougher spots.

items.title: 6 x 6 mixers
items.text: Six-wheel drive trucks that cross terrain conventional trucks would never attempt, and keep you working after bad weather.

items.title: Pump truck services
items.text: Two 36-meter pumps at 190 yards per hour and a 70-foot boom pump at 50 yards per hour for the hardest-to-reach placements.

items.title: Grout pump services
items.text: Two truck-mounted grout pumps with 300 feet of hose, pumping 20 yards per hour. Ideal for retaining walls and blockfill.

items.title: Mobile batching plants
items.text: Concrete batched where your project is.

sections.title: Three trucks, one family, *one mission*
body: In June of 1985, Davis Hauling Company decided to enter the ready mix business. Charles Davis had over 30 years in hauling and knew the industry well as a supplier of aggregate to local operations. He founded Augusta Ready Mix with his son, Terry Davis.

Since the first load went onto truck number one of three that July, we have grown into the leading full-service concrete supplier in the Central Savannah River Area. Our mission has stayed the same: give the customer a quality product when he wants it, and in the time intervals that he wants it. Just as in the early days, do not be surprised if your order is delivered by Terry.
